verdict.rationale: The options present unresolved tradeoffs without a stated priority. A maximizes savings and includes pool/hot-tub access; B combines a relatively low rate, high rating, and close walkable location; C maximizes meeting convenience through direct connection and an event desk; and D maximizes amenities and quiet rooms. Since all rates and transportation options are acceptable and no preference weights price, proximity, amenities, quiet, or event support, no option clearly dominates.
